overall_summary: Analysis of deduplicated YouTube Shorts performance indicates that extreme space and planetary curiosity hooks—specifically 'What If' scenarios regarding exotic worlds and extreme physical anomalies—significantly outperform general science or biological trivia. Videos focusing on bizarre cosmic bodies, extreme planetary environments (e.g., diamond, liquid metal, and dark planets), and high-stakes speculative physics yield the highest view counts and engagement ratios (likes-per-view), whereas standard psychological and biological facts show lower traction in this sample set.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,029 views, 38 likes) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes) rapidly outpace standard historical or psychological trivia.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical space disaster/exploration scenarios focusing on bizarre, scientifically plausible exoplanets with extreme environmental properties.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles featuring extreme visual or physical contradictions such as 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (1,031 views, 36 likes) and 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (981 views, 21 likes) drive high immediate curiosity and engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Continue framing space facts around counterintuitive physical laws or extreme anomalies using high-contrast visual hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Shorts like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (5-53 views) and 'The Psychological Trick to Stop Songs Stuck in Your Head' (71 views) demonstrate low relative velocity and minimal engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize micro-psychology and internal brain tricks unless paired with a high-stakes, cinematic visual hook or shocking neurological anomaly.

weak_patterns.evidence: Content centered on standard biological facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (moderate views but inconsistent velocity) underperform compared to space exploration and planetary physics.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal-related content strictly toward cinematic survival or extreme evolutionary anomalies rather than basic static trivia.
